# The API groups Instead budgets a connection's requests under — one owner for the
# throttle that paces a worker and the gauge that reports a response.
module TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::RateLimitGroup
  NAMES = Settings.tax_automations.instead.rate_limit_groups.to_h.keys.map(&:to_s).freeze

  class << self
    # @param name [String, nil] the group a worker declares, or the first segment of a request path — `docs`
    # @return [String] the name when settings budget it, otherwise `default`
    def of(name)
      NAMES.include?(name.to_s) ? name.to_s : 'default'
    end
  end
end

# The vendor refusals a send step answers rather than raises, since every attempt gets the
# same answer; any other client error goes to the retry ladder.
module TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::RefusalsHelper
  module_function

  TERMINAL_ERRORS = [
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::QuotaExceededError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::TokenRefreshable::InvalidGrantError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::UnauthorizedError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::ForbiddenError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::NotFoundError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::LockedError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::BadRequestError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::UnprocessableEntityError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::TargetIncompleteError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::TargetExpiredError,
    AbstractPolicy::PolicyError
  ].freeze

  # The refusals whose reason is not `api_error`.
  REASONS = {
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::QuotaExceededError => :exceeded,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::InsufficientScopeError => :unauthorized,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::TokenRefreshable::InvalidGrantError => :unauthorized,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::UnauthorizedError => :unauthorized,
    AbstractPolicy::PolicyError => :forbidden
  }.freeze

  # Refusals the worker base answers, not the step: it kills the job and, for a grant, starts its verification.
  RAISED_ERRORS = [AbstractPolicy::PolicyError, TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::TokenRefreshable::InvalidGrantError].freeze

  # Refusals the vendor gives only when its contract or our configuration moved — a firm cannot lift them.
  REPORTED_ERRORS = [
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::InsufficientScopeError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::BadRequestError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::UnprocessableEntityError,
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::TargetIncompleteError
  ].freeze

  # @param error [StandardError] one of `TERMINAL_ERRORS`
  # @return [Symbol] one of `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Document::FAILURE_REASONS`
  def reason_for(error)
    error_class = REASONS.keys.find { |refusal_class| error.is_a?(refusal_class) }
    REASONS.fetch(error_class, :api_error)
  end

  # Ends the step's files under `reason_for(error)` — a system transition, scoped to the connection's firm since the
  # system passes every policy; the caller answers the refusal, and a policy refusal or a refused grant is raised on.
  #
  # @param error [StandardError] one of `TERMINAL_ERRORS`
  # @param tax_automation_documents [Array<TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Document>]
  # @param connection [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::HasOauthConnection]
  # @return [void]
  # @raise [AbstractPolicy::PolicyError] the refusal itself, once the files are ended
  def refuse!(error, tax_automation_documents, connection)
    reason = reason_for(error)

    report_refusal(error, tax_automation_documents, connection) if REPORTED_ERRORS.any? { |error_class| error.is_a?(error_class) }
    own_documents = Array(tax_automation_documents).select { |tax_automation_document| tax_automation_document.firm_id == connection.firm_id }
    system_actor = System.new
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::FailUpload.call(system_actor.user, system_actor, own_documents, reason)
    raise error if RAISED_ERRORS.any? { |error_class| error.is_a?(error_class) }
  end

  def report_refusal(error, tax_automation_documents, connection)
    tags = {error_context: Settings.product_clusters.tax_preparation, provider: tax_automation_documents.first.provider}
    contexts = {tax_automations: {connection_id: connection.id, tax_automation_document_ids: tax_automation_documents.map(&:id)}}

    ErrorReporter.report(error, tags, contexts)
  end
end

# The sends a lost webhook left in an intermediate status, across firms, and the connection each firm's
# reconciliation runs on. Read only.
module TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::ReconcileCandidatesQuery
  module_function

  # By `uploaded_at`; `Settings.tax_automations.<provider>.<name>` overrides each, in seconds.
  SENT_AFTER = 1.hour
  PROCESSING_AFTER = 12.hours
  GIVE_UP_AFTER = 2.days

  # `sent` past `sent_after`, `processing` past `processing_after`, as `id` and `firm_id` only.
  def list_candidates(provider)
    processing_after = Settings.dig(:tax_automations, provider, :processing_after) || PROCESSING_AFTER
    processing_uploaded_at = ..(Time.current - processing_after)
    processing = list_uploaded_tax_automation_documents(provider).processing_status_processing.where(uploaded_at: processing_uploaded_at)

    list_sent_tax_automation_documents(provider).or(processing).select(:id, :firm_id).to_a
  end

  def list_sent_tax_automation_documents(provider)
    sent_after = Settings.dig(:tax_automations, provider, :sent_after) || SENT_AFTER
    sent_uploaded_at = ..(Time.current - sent_after)

    list_uploaded_tax_automation_documents(provider).processing_status_sent.where(uploaded_at: sent_uploaded_at)
  end

  # `nil` for a firm without a live grant, an Owner to run as, or the provider on offer — left to the next tick.
  def find_reconcilable_connection(adapter, provider, firm_id)
    FirmContext.with_firm(firm_id) do
      connection = adapter::Connection.connected.find_by(firm_id:)
      next if connection.nil?
      next if connection.firm.owner.nil? || !TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Registry.provider_available?(provider, connection.firm)

      connection
    end
  end

  # Uploaded no longer ago than `give_up_after`; older sends are left as they are.
  def list_uploaded_tax_automation_documents(provider)
    give_up_after = Settings.dig(:tax_automations, provider, :give_up_after) || GIVE_UP_AFTER
    uploaded_at = ((Time.current - give_up_after)..)

    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Document.where(provider:).upload_status_uploaded.where(uploaded_at:)
  end
  private_class_method :list_uploaded_tax_automation_documents
end

# Every 30 minutes: hands the sends a lost webhook left in an intermediate status to their adapter, which reads
# the vendor back; a firm the provider is not offered to is skipped. Makes no exchange itself.
class TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::ReconcileSweepWorker < TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::ApplicationWorker
  # Three retries: a tick that keeps failing is replaced by the next one 30 minutes later.
  sidekiq_options queue: :tax_preparation_tax_automations_low, lock: :until_executed, on_conflict: :log, retry: 3

  class << self
    # The `sent` sends a tick hands over, for the `stale_sends` gauge.
    def count_stale_sends(adapter)
      provider = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Registry.provider_of(adapter)
      stale_sends_by_firm_id = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::ReconcileCandidatesQuery.list_sent_tax_automation_documents(provider).group(:firm_id).count

      stale_sends_by_firm_id.sum do |firm_id, stale_sends|
        TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::ReconcileCandidatesQuery.find_reconcilable_connection(adapter, provider, firm_id).present? ? stale_sends : 0
      end
    end
  end

  def perform
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Registry.adapters.each do |adapter|
      provider = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Registry.provider_of(adapter)
      candidates = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::ReconcileCandidatesQuery.list_candidates(provider)

      candidates.group_by(&:firm_id).each do |firm_id, tax_automation_documents|
        reconcile(adapter, provider, firm_id, tax_automation_documents.map(&:id))
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def reconcile(adapter, provider, firm_id, tax_automation_document_ids)
    connection = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::ReconcileCandidatesQuery.find_reconcilable_connection(adapter, provider, firm_id)
    return if connection.nil?

    owner = connection.firm.owner
    FirmContext.with_firm(firm_id) do
      adapter::Documents::ReconcileStatusesAsync.call(owner.user, owner, connection, {tax_automation_document_ids:})
    end
  end
end

# One page of an entity's `/{year}/` folder, read back onto the sends a lost webhook left stale. Answers the
# candidates no page named yet, with the next page's token while one remains.
class TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Documents::ReconcileStatuses
  include KindOfService

  attr_reader :user, :actor, :connection, :params

  # @!method self.call(user, actor, connection, params)
  #   @param user [User] - required
  #   @param actor [Owner] - required
  #   @param connection [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Connection] - required
  #   @param params [Hash] - required
  #     @option params [Integer] :instead_entity_id - required
  #     @option params [Integer] :year - required; the folder `/{year}/`
  #     @option params [Array<Integer>] :tax_automation_document_ids - required; the candidates no page named yet
  #     @option params [String, nil] :page_token
  #   @return [ServiceResult] success: `{tax_automation_document_ids:, page_token:}` while a candidate is unseen,
  #     `page_token` nil after the last page; else no payload. A folder or entity Instead no longer holds is skipped
  def initialize(user, actor, connection, params)
    @user = user
    @actor = actor
    @connection = connection
    @params = params
  end

  private

  def perform
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::ConnectionPolicy.authorize!(user, actor, :read, connection)

    entity = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Entity.find(params[:instead_entity_id])
    page = api_client.list_docs(path: "/#{params[:year]}/", entity_uuid: entity.external_uuid, page_token: params[:page_token])
    unseen = apply_page(page['Files'].to_a)
    return success if unseen.empty?

    success(tax_automation_document_ids: unseen, page_token: page['NextPageToken'])
  rescue TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::NotFoundError, TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Client::EntityForbiddenError => e
    log(INFO) { "Instead reconciliation skipped folder /#{params[:year]}/ of entity #{params[:instead_entity_id]}: #{e.class}" }

    success
  end

  # @return [Array<Integer>] the candidates this page did not name
  def apply_page(files)
    vendor_documents = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Document.
      where(tax_automation_document_id: params[:tax_automation_document_ids], instead_entity_id: params[:instead_entity_id]).
      lazy_preload(:tax_automation_document).
      index_by(&:external_uuid)
    seen = []

    files.each do |file|
      vendor_document = vendor_documents[file['UUID']]
      next if vendor_document.nil?

      seen << vendor_document.tax_automation_document_id
      next if file['IndexStatus'].blank?

      apply(vendor_document.tax_automation_document, vendor_status: file['IndexStatus'], index_error_reason: file['IndexErrorReason'])
    end

    params[:tax_automation_document_ids] - seen
  end

  # An `IndexStatus` outside the fold skips its row rather than the page.
  def apply(tax_automation_document, file_state)
    system = System.new
    result = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Documents::ApplyProcessingStatus.call(system.user, system, tax_automation_document, file_state)
    return if result.data.nil?

    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Metrics.emit_reconciled(connection, result.data)
  rescue KeyError
    log(INFO) { "Instead reconciliation skipped document #{tax_automation_document.id}: unknown IndexStatus #{file_state[:vendor_status]}" }
  end

  def api_client
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Client.new(connection)
  end
end

# A candidate no folder page named, read back on its own: archived when Instead no longer holds the file, else the
# `IndexStatus` of the folder it moved to.
class TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Documents::ReconcileStatus
  include KindOfService

  attr_reader :user, :actor, :connection, :params

  # @!method self.call(user, actor, connection, params)
  #   @param user [User] - required
  #   @param actor [Owner] - required
  #   @param connection [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Connection] - required
  #   @param params [Hash] - required
  #     @option params [Integer] :instead_entity_id - required
  #     @option params [Integer] :tax_automation_document_id - required
  #   @return [ServiceResult] success, no payload; a file carrying no `IndexStatus` or one outside the fold writes nothing
  def initialize(user, actor, connection, params)
    @user = user
    @actor = actor
    @connection = connection
    @params = params
  end

  private

  def perform
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::ConnectionPolicy.authorize!(user, actor, :read, connection)

    entity = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Entity.find(params[:instead_entity_id])
    vendor_document = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Document.find_by!(tax_automation_document_id: params[:tax_automation_document_id], instead_entity_id: entity.id)
    file_state = read_file_state(entity, vendor_document)
    apply(vendor_document.tax_automation_document, file_state) if file_state.present?

    success
  end

  # @return [Hash, nil] `ApplyProcessingStatus` params; nil for a file that carries no `IndexStatus`
  def read_file_state(entity, vendor_document)
    file = api_client.get_doc(vendor_document.external_uuid, entity_uuid: entity.external_uuid)
    return if file['IndexStatus'].blank?

    {vendor_status: file['IndexStatus'], index_error_reason: file['IndexErrorReason']}
  rescue TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::NotFoundError
    {vendor_status: 'archived'}
  end

  def apply(tax_automation_document, file_state)
    system = System.new
    result = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Documents::ApplyProcessingStatus.call(system.user, system, tax_automation_document, file_state)
    return if result.data.nil?

    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Metrics.emit_reconciled(connection, result.data)
  rescue KeyError
    log(INFO) { "Instead reconciliation skipped document #{tax_automation_document.id}: unknown IndexStatus #{file_state[:vendor_status]}" }
  end

  def api_client
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Client.new(connection)
  end
end

# What Instead says about a file — its `IndexStatus` or its archive — as the send's
# `processing_status`. The webhook processor and the reconciliation both write through here.
class TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Documents::ApplyProcessingStatus
  include KindOfService

  class StatusRefusedError < ServiceError; end

  # Every word Instead has for a file: its `IndexStatus` (`processing` on the upserted
  # delivery, `completed` or `failed` on the indexed one), or `archived` once it put the file away.
  PROCESSING_STATUS_BY_VENDOR_STATUS = {'processing' => :processing, 'completed' => :processed, 'failed' => :error, 'archived' => :archived}.freeze

  # Instead's `IndexErrorReason` tokens that have a word of ours; any other refusal
  # ends the send in `error` with no reason.
  FAILURE_REASON_BY_INDEX_ERROR_REASON = {'password_required' => :encrypted}.freeze

  # @!method self.call(user, actor, tax_automation_document, params)
  #   @param user [User, nil] - the system actor's
  #   @param actor [System] - required; only the system actor may write a status
  #   @param tax_automation_document [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Document] - required
  #   @param params [Hash] - required
  #     @option params [String] :vendor_status - required; one of `PROCESSING_STATUS_BY_VENDOR_STATUS.keys`
  #     @option params [String, nil] :index_error_reason - read beside `failed` only
  #   @return [ServiceResult] success: the status written (`Symbol`), nil when the record
  #     already held it or the machine refused a report behind it
  def initialize(user, actor, tax_automation_document, params)
    @user = user
    @actor = actor
    @tax_automation_document = tax_automation_document
    @params = params
  end

  private

  def perform
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::DocumentPolicy.authorize!(@user, @actor, :update_status, @tax_automation_document)

    processing_status = PROCESSING_STATUS_BY_VENDOR_STATUS.fetch(@params[:vendor_status].to_s)
    return success if @tax_automation_document.processing_status == processing_status.to_s

    failure_reason = FAILURE_REASON_BY_INDEX_ERROR_REASON[@params[:index_error_reason].to_s]
    # The machine reaches `processed` from `error` only through `processing`.
    transaction do
      update_status!(@user, @actor, @tax_automation_document, :processing) if processing_status == :processed && @tax_automation_document.error?
      update_status!(@user, @actor, @tax_automation_document, processing_status, failure_reason)
    end

    success(processing_status)
  rescue StatusRefusedError
    success
  end

  # The port refuses a report behind the record and a record deleted since the lookup; either takes the walk back.
  def update_status!(user, actor, tax_automation_document, processing_status, failure_reason = nil)
    result = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::UpdateStatus.call(user, actor, tax_automation_document.id, processing_status:, failure_reason:)
    raise StatusRefusedError, result.errors if result.failed?
  end
end

# The entity `CreateEntity` opened, held per workflow for the callback that fans the files
# out — an operation hands the next step no payload.
module TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::LinkedEntityBuffer
  module_function

  # Outlives any send, however long its retries stretch.
  TTL = 1.day.to_i

  # @param workflow_id [Integer]
  # @return [String]
  def key_for(workflow_id)
    "tax_automations:instead:linked_entity_buffer:#{workflow_id}"
  end

  # @param key [String] from {.key_for}
  # @param entity [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Entity]
  # @return [void]
  def write(key, entity)
    RedisConnection.with_tax_preparation_pool { |redis| redis.set(key, entity.id, ex: TTL) }
  end

  # @param key [String] from {.key_for}
  # @return [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Entity, nil]
  def read(key)
    entity_id = RedisConnection.with_tax_preparation_pool { |redis| redis.get(key) }
    return if entity_id.blank?

    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Entity.find_by(id: entity_id)
  end
end
